## Summary

Describe the focused change and the problem it solves.

## Related issue

Link the issue or explain why one is not needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Web application tests pass.
- [ ] Audit engine tests pass.
- [ ] Python compilation check passes.
- [ ] JavaScript syntax check passes.
- [ ] Documentation is updated in Chinese and English where applicable.

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] Public-URL and read-only boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] No secrets, private reports, customer data, or real `.env` values are included.
- [ ] Compatibility or migration impact is documented.
- [ ] New code and assets are compatible with Apache-2.0 and include attribution when required.
